title: Performance
subtitle: Productive time across your team, based on how you classify apps and websites.

report.errorRange: The start date must be before the end date.
report.coverageSub: Share of active time with a rule
report.lowCoverage: Only {{pct}}% of active time is classified, so scores may be misleading.
report.disclaimer: Scores show how time was spent in classified apps and websites. They do not measure the quality of work and should not be the only basis for decisions about people.

rules.subtitle: Mark the apps and websites your team uses as productive, neutral or unproductive.
rules.targetHelp: Expected productive time per working day. Used for "Daily target reached".
rules.targetInvalid: Enter a number of hours between 1 and 24.
rules.addAppPlaceholder: Add an app by name, e.g. Visual Studio Code
rules.appHelp: Browser time is split by the websites visited, so classify websites as well as apps. Unclassified time is never counted as unproductive.
rules.domainHelp: A rule for a domain also covers its subdomains: "google.com" includes "mail.google.com" unless that has its own rule.
